name: g6 filter+optional — Account (Postgres, FILTER healthScore) ⋈ Document (ArangoDB, OPTIONAL filename) on accountId
sparql: PREFIX c: <urn:arango-sparql:concept#> SELECT ?accountName ?healthScore ?source ?filename WHERE { ?a a c:Account ; c:accountName ?accountName ; c:healthScore ?healthScore ; c:accountId ?acct . ?d a c:Document ; c:source ?source ; c:accountId ?acct . FILTER(?healthScore > 7) OPTIONAL { ?d c:filename ?filename } }
